paragraphs.en: The conceited man greeted the little prince with excitement.
paragraphs.zh: 这个自以为是的人兴奋地迎接小王子。

paragraphs.en: "Ah! Ah! I am about to receive a visit from an admirer!"
paragraphs.zh: “啊！啊！我要接待一位仰慕者来访了！”

paragraphs.en: he exclaimed when seeing the little prince approach.
paragraphs.zh: 他看到小王子走近时不禁脱口喊道。

paragraphs.en: For all other men are seen as admirers by such people.
paragraphs.zh: 对于这些人而言，其他所有人都是他们的仰慕者。

paragraphs.en: "Good morning," said the little prince, noticing the strange hat on the conceited man's head. "That is a queer hat you are wearing."
paragraphs.zh: “早上好，”小王子注意到傲慢先生头上戴着一顶奇怪的帽子，“你戴的是个挺特别的帽子。”

paragraphs.en: "It is for salutes," replied the conceited man. "People raise it when they acclaim me. But nobody passes this way."
paragraphs.zh: “这是用来致意的，”那个自以为是的人回答说，“人们在我面前举起来表示欢迎。但这里很少有人经过。”

paragraphs.en: "Yes?" said the little prince, not understanding.
"Clap your hands," instructed the conceited man.
paragraphs.zh: “拍手吧，”那个自以为是的人吩咐道。

paragraphs.en: The little prince obeyed and clapped his hands. The conceited man raised his hat in a modest salute.
paragraphs.zh: 小王子遵照指示拍了拍手。虚荣的人摘下帽子，谦逊地行了一礼。

paragraphs.en: "This is more entertaining than visiting the king," thought the little prince. He began to clap again, but after five minutes, he grew bored.
paragraphs.zh: “这比去见国王还要有趣呢。”小王子心想。他又开始鼓掌，但五分钟后便感到无聊了。

paragraphs.en: "And what should one do to make the hat come down?" he asked.
paragraphs.zh: “那应该怎么做才能让帽子掉下来呢？”他问道。

paragraphs.en: The conceited man did not hear him, as he only listened for praise.
paragraphs.zh: 自视甚高的男子没有听到他的话，因为他只盼着听赞美之词。

paragraphs.en: "Do you really admire me very much?" he demanded of the little prince.
paragraphs.zh: “你真的非常欣赏我吗？”他问那位小王子。

paragraphs.en: "To admire means regarding me as the handsomest, best-dressed, richest, and most intelligent man on this planet," explained the conceited man. "Do me a kindness and admire me."
paragraphs.zh: 自以为是的男人解释说：“欣赏我的意思是认为我是这个星球上最英俊、衣着最好的、最富有的、最有智慧的人。”他恳求道，“请赏脸，欣赏我吧。”

paragraphs.en: "I admire you," said the little prince, shrugging. "But what is there in that to interest you so much?"
paragraphs.zh: “我钦佩你，”小王子耸了耸肩说，“但你为何对这一点如此感兴趣？”

paragraphs.en: The little prince then continued his journey.
paragraphs.zh: 小王子继续踏上他的旅程。

paragraphs.en: "The grown-ups are certainly very odd," he thought to himself.
paragraphs.zh: 他心想：“那些大人真是奇怪得很。”
